title: Let the Bani cool what is burning
summary: The Lord's Bani cools the heart like nectar taken in again. Let repeated hearing answer the inner fire before another reaction speaks for you.
takeaway: Let repeated hearing cool the burn before a reaction takes over.
lifeApplication: When agitation rises in the chest, read the line aloud again slowly enough for the body to hear it before you reply, decide, or reach elsewhere.
